zh.title: 阿聯酋航空最老空中巴士A380客機持續執飛英國航線
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空車齡近21年的空中巴士A380月初執飛三個英國機場。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，阿聯酋航空旗下機齡最老的一架空中巴士A380客機，目前車齡已接近21年。該架雙層客機目前仍維持運作，並在全航網中執飛商業航班任務。
在航線部署方面，這架車齡接近21年的空中巴士A380客機在本月初期間，共計飛往了三個位於英國的不同機場。
過往特定紀錄顯示，阿聯酋航空工程部門先前已推動一項高達數十億美元的改裝計畫，將全面翻新旗下219架空中巴士A380與波音777客機。

en.title: Emirates' Oldest Airbus A380 Continues Operations to Three UK Airports
en.summary: Emirates operates its nearly 21-year-old Airbus A380 to three UK airports at month start.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, Emirates' oldest Airbus A380 aircraft is now nearly 21 years old. Despite its age, the double-deck widebody jet continues to remain in active commercial service for the airline.
Regarding recent operational routes, the aircraft flew to three different airports in the United Kingdom at the start of the month, maintaining its scheduled operations across international flights.

According to historical aviation records, Emirates Engineering previously initiated a multi-billion-dollar retrofit program aimed at fully refurbishing a total of 219 aircraft, consisting of Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 models across its long-haul fleet.
